title: admitPoolMemberInput
description: The request `admit-pool-member.mjs` reads (NDJSON stdin, or the same fields as --flags): the pool's own founding fields, present only when its state document does not yet exist, plus the member being admitted.

poolId.description: Local pool id, namespaced into a ledger account via poolAccountId.

settlementWindowDays.description: Days a draw has to settle before its half-tally is "old".

creditWindowDays.description: Lookback window for counting matched tallies toward a member's line; defaults to 90.

poolHiveAccount.description: The pool's own Hive account, the settlement source for a draw's transfer intent; null (unarmed) until the founder names one.

account.description: The member's internal pool-ledger account id.

hiveAccount.description: The Hive account name an HBD draw settles to.

baseAddress.description: The Base address a USDC directed-yield contribution or distribution settles to; two rails, one ledger.

ledgerPath.description: Path to the member's own declared ledger (the second witness).

admissionWitness.description: Optional: when present, verified per the membership-and-governance specification's three admission paths before the member is admitted; when absent, the pool's own unwitnessed admission applies unchanged.

admittedAt.description: Required for a receipt to be recorded, and for staleness checks against a turntide-islander-role witness's checkedAt; omit to admit with no receipt.
